correctness.rationale: For all integers p,q>=2, a strict trace-inverse Hessian on the zero-sum subspace implies global uniqueness after averaging every unrestricted symmetric feasible walk. Tensor eigenvalues yield the exact Kemeny objective and stochastic budget. Homogeneous scaling proves no holding; exact differentiation reduces to q*t^3*(t+2)=p*(2*t+1), whose unique positive root is verified using a strictly increasing quotient. A uniform small-t expansion proves the cubic-root asymptotics, and SLEM norm convexity plus three spectral constraints proves the fastest-mixing 9/8 benchmark. The extracted checker independently computes 990 finite rational/numerical checks; finite tests are not used to prove universal claims.
